# Hyperwrike

> AI systems agency. We build custom AI voice agents, CRM automation, lead generation, and ecommerce AI for businesses in India, UK, US and Europe.

## What we build

- **AI Voice Calling Agent**: 24/7 AI receptionist that answers calls, qualifies callers, books appointments, and runs outbound reminders in natural conversation — including Tanglish. Proven to reduce no-shows by 40% (VS Hospitals, Chennai).
- **AI Chatbot & Conversational AI**: Intelligent sales agent for website, WhatsApp, and social media — qualifies leads, handles objections, captures contact details, 3× more leads captured.
- **Ecommerce AI Platform**: Recommendation engine, abandoned-cart recovery, and dormant-customer re-engagement running on autopilot.
- **Custom CRM & Operations AI**: Bespoke CRM replacing spreadsheets and manual admin — payments, compliance, live dashboards. Saves 100+ hours/month (Pannasuna Chit Funds, India).
- **AI Lead Generation & SDR**: Automated outbound system that finds ideal customers, personalises outreach, and books discovery calls — 60–80% lower cost per meeting than a human SDR.

## Who we serve

Industries: hospitals & clinics, dental & physio, law firms, financial services (chit funds, NBFCs), ecommerce, B2B SaaS, professional services.
Regions: India (live systems deployed), United Kingdom, United States, Europe.

## Key facts

- Systems go live in approximately 21 days
- Every system ships with a reporting layer showing hours saved, revenue recovered, calls handled — every week
- Clients own the system: fully documented, trainable, yours forever
- Ongoing retainer: Hyperwrike monitors, optimises, and expands as your business grows
- Guarantee: every system pays for itself within 60–90 days or we keep working
- Founded: 2024 | HQ: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

## Proven results

- VS Hospitals (Chennai): 40% fewer no-shows, zero missed after-hours calls
- Pannasuna Chit Funds (India): 100+ hours saved per month, zero missed follow-ups
